analysis.failures: Retain every seed, failed gate, exception and deadline-censored run; never substitute a more favorable seed.
analysis.historical_comparison: Existing LLM arms each have one search seed and model-budget termination. Compare curves only over overlapping actual evaluation counts; a 500-state cap is not evidence that existing arms consumed 500 states. Continuations use inherited graphs and must be shown separately from common-root searches.
analysis.inference_limit: Five baseline seeds quantify baseline variability, not LLM-method replication or a statistically established method advantage.
analysis.primary: Additional jointly feasible deletions versus cumulative new evaluated states; final distributions across all five seeds.

authorization.scope: User authorized design and implementation of baseline investigation. Existing $50 approval remains assigned to continuation and validation.

auxiliary: zero model calls and model spend
budget_accounting.primary: Unique new candidate states, including failed growth gates; root evaluation separate. Incomplete evaluations counted as attempted and reported separately.
budget_accounting.resume: Reconstruct proposals from persistent graph, retain original absolute deadline and total state/step caps. Resume never resets budget.

product.description: $0.8064 per On Demand Linux m7i.4xlarge Instance Hour

cost_proposal.runtime_estimate: Unknown until measured; ten jobs, four at a time, each capped at six hours; worst-case three waves plus setup and archival within 24 hours. This is a cap, not a promised completion ETA.

held_out_validation.requested_followup: Cost and approve validation separately, retaining the prior 20-generation, three-seed protocol and uniform numerical checks. No validation is launched by this search runner.
held_out_validation.selection: Nominate one final jointly feasible state per run using the frozen ordering; deduplicate exact genotypes. Report no improvement explicitly. Freeze the entire nomination list before any vEcoli results.

launch_requirements: New experiment-specific cost approval and authorized tracking-credential transfer if needed
Fresh price check and dedicated worker identity
Restore and verify all scientific inputs and exact Linux package versions
Install bounded science and absolute shutdown timers before dispatch; verify timers survive any reboot
Run offline smoke tests on frozen deployment before loading models; enforce maximum four simultaneous jobs
Freeze approval with exact protocol SHA, worker, spending cap and absolute deadlines; preserve worker data on backup failure
Publish final catalog and independently verify archive members before removing worker disk

policy.block_definition: Gene sets, not necessarily chromosome-contiguous intervals. The final partition block may be smaller.
policy.eligible_genes: All undeleted genes in the same 4290-gene registry. Do not silently exclude essential annotations.
policy.exhaustion: Stop when no unseen block remains at the incumbent; this is a local heuristic, not proof of global minimality.
policy.greedy_block: Sampled best improvement. Evaluate up to eight ordered candidates from the same parent, then retain the best feasible incumbent.
policy.parent_and_finalist_order: deletion count descending, FBA growth descending, state ID ascending
policy.proposal_order: Sort undeleted canonical genes by SHA256(block-v1:seed:parent_state_id:gene), partition at each size; skip evaluated states and duplicate blocks.
policy.randomized_block: First feasible improvement. One candidate at a time, retaining the best feasible incumbent.
policy.schedule: Coarse to fine. Exhaust unseen blocks at a resolution before trying smaller ones. A successful descendant never resets to a larger block resolution.

purpose: Competent non-LLM controls for gene-deletion search, with independently replicated policy seeds and the same scientific evaluators.

reproducibility.backups: Read-only SQLite backup/quick_check; data-only content-addressed archives and member indexes; full S3 GET SHA256 and COMMITTED W&B download checks before advancing.
reproducibility.canonical_data: Per-run SQLite graph containing every state, evaluation, decision and proposal. Curves/results are derived, never a replacement for the graph.
reproducibility.credentials: Never bundled or printed; configured credentials and credential patterns screened before upload.
reproducibility.snapshots: Protocol, genotype, input data, runtime source and evaluator SHA256 identities checked before execution; all installed package versions captured.
reproducibility.source: Source snapshots retained as source locally and deployed as code, excluded from scientific data archives.
